scope: Foliage motion diagnosis and RR preview, no global graphics-quality or universal 60 FPS claim

isolation.nativeNoDlss: Confirmed full 2560x1440 target, no NGX create/evaluate, no jitter; texture/lighting temporal variation persists
isolation.nativeDirectOnlyLeaves: Foliage direct composition excludes GI, sky fill and local emission, retains stochastic direct sunlight and camera aerial. Variation only partially reduced, so GI alone does not explain artifact. Other materials keep GI. Raw GI still calculated but not composed onto leaves.
isolation.originalMotion: 0% valid on visible leaves, GI history always 1
isolation.fix: Visible alpha-tested raster layer authorizes camera reprojection only when foliage wind is zero. 100% valid in capture, independently checked against captured first-visible depth/matrices.
isolation.mip: World-space triangle UV gradients and camera pixel footprint, incidence correction, atlas-level/sprite-bound clamping. This is an initial camera-sized ray-footprint estimate, not full accumulated BSDF cone propagation. Shadow, diffuse, rough, mirror and water hit sampling use it in realtime mode. Explicit diagnostic/emitter point samples retain their existing policy.
isolation.lodBias: RayCameraPosition.w carries log2(actual input/output width), approximately -0.58468 for 1707/2560 and zero at native; applied to raster derivatives and ray footprint. No extra -1 sharpening offset.

pairedQuality.interpretation: Reprojected absolute RGB differences, includes residual texture aliasing and moving visibility. Not a pure noise variance, ghosting-length or perceptual score. Visual strips and actual PNG frames retained.

guides: specular hit distance and actual jitter-free camera matrices
rr.guideValidation: All 8 buffers finite; leaf normal unit-length max error 0.0004883 at fp16. Albedo range 0..1; specular hit distance 0..128.
rr.customFilters: Diffuse spatial/temporal, rough specular filters and sun temporal filter culled by raw bindings; independent cloud cache remains.
limitations: Animated wind and per-object entity vectors are not implemented; qualified foliage is undeformed.
Cloud/water-specific guide fidelity and long-session temporal stability are outside this eight-frame foliage qualification.
Specular guide uses approximate current material model; not calibrated resource-pack PBR.
rr.guideDistanceSource: Actual rough first hit for rough materials, actual mirror hit for smooth metals; miss uses traced maximum 128. Mirror-specific image quality not qualified by the foliage scene.
